activities.title: Lab 1 Part A: build your master folder
activities.intro: Work on your own Desktop and use your real name. Tick each step as you finish it. Keep this folder: you will use it again in 1.3 and 1.5.

items: Right-click the Desktop › New › Folder. Name it DPE Lab 1 - Juan Dela Cruz (your own name).
Open it. Create two sub-folders: 01 Screenshots and 02 AI Responses.
Inside the master folder, right-click › New › Text Document. Name it Practice Note.
Press F2 and rename it with today's date: YYYY-MM-DD Note - Practice.
Copy it into 01 Screenshots, then cut and paste it into 02 AI Responses.
Delete the copy in 01 Screenshots, then restore it from the Recycle Bin.

blocks.prompt: How many sub-folders are inside your master folder?
What are the names of your sub-folders?
Which key renames the selected file or folder?
After step 6, where is your practice note?
options: In both 01 Screenshots and 02 AI Responses

blocks.prompt: Optional: a screenshot of your master folder in File Explorer

help: Made a "New folder" and forgot to name it? Select it and press F2 to rename it.
Check that you are inside the right folder before you create or name something.
Deleted the wrong thing? Ctrl + Z undoes it, or restore it from the Recycle Bin.
